scope: Python brain pipeline for a future browser-app backend; the brain pipeline is not yet connected to a web upload endpoint

input.source: Local uploaded file path; the caller creates an authenticated PublicMediaRequest using its actual SHA-256 and byte size
input.source_provenance: Source origin and cloud-use basis must describe the actual upload; do not mark arbitrary uploads as project-generated fixtures
input.audio: Native decoded audio clock; no visual input is fabricated
input.text: UTF-8 text and an explicit words_per_minute argument; CLI --words-per-minute
input.image_or_pdf: An explicit seconds_per_page list with one value per actual page; CLI --seconds-per-page
input.duration_limits: At least 45 seconds for the current EEG head. Text cloud inference is limited to 30 minutes; other prototype rendering and transport bounds are enforced by their adapters.
input.output_directory: A new directory for every attempt. Existing partial outputs are preserved and require inspection before recovery.

execution.browser: Uploads content and displays job progress/results through a backend; it does not execute every model in-browser
execution.local_Python_orchestrator: Checks source identity, prepares media, calls remote feature models, and runs the fitted EEG head
execution.Modal: Native TRIBE and SAM Audio GPU inference on permitted content
execution.Meta_API: Applicable voice, semantics, and SAM visual feature extraction
execution.credentials: Owner-only .local/brain-credentials.json; never send credentials to the browser or serialize them in result artifacts
execution.parallelism: One project GPU request at a time. The video pipeline may run hosted visual and speech/semantic extraction alongside the serialized GPU branch.
execution.failure_recovery: Inspect saved stage status and .local/brain-dispatches. Recover the same function-call handle after a local observation failure. No automatic paid retry.

outputs.EEG_query_seconds: Content/presentation query times at a 5-second hop
outputs.EEG_features: N by 8: four channel means followed by four log1p variances, ordered TP9, AF7, AF8, TP10
outputs.EEG_supported: Temporal feature coverage only; not a scientific-confidence or physiological-validity score
outputs.cortical_response: Native TRIBE average-subject predictions with 20,484 cortical vertices
outputs.cortical_clock: Use fmri_segment_starts_native and fmri_segment_durations_native. Preserve native offsets and gaps; do not assume these arrays share the EEG query clock.
outputs.cortical_surface: Optional brain.surface export with the qualified template geometry; no validated anatomical-region labels are supplied
outputs.raw_content_features: Retained in modality-specific subdirectories for inspection and future research; supplemental features are not all predictors of the nonvideo EEG heads
outputs.JSON_conversion: NPZ arrays can contain NaN at unsupported EEG slots. Convert these to null for JSON transport and retain the support mask; do not display them as zero-valued measurements.

consumer_requirements.model_status: Read docs/brain_model_card_v1.json and display predictions as an unvalidated experimental model
consumer_requirements.performance: The all-block held-out EEG model is worse than its training-mean baseline. Successful execution is not evidence of useful neural prediction.
consumer_requirements.physical_domain: Check diagnostics.json or transfer-diagnostics.json for negative predicted log1p variances. Such raw regression outputs are outside the target's physical domain and must not be described as observed physiological signals.
consumer_requirements.nonvideo: Display assumed reading/page timing and experimental transfer status; no measured gaze or real nonvideo neural validation is implied
